story.title: Floods Force Thousands From Homes in Central Europe
story.summary: Heavy rain has caused rivers to burst their banks in Austria and Czechia, and thousands of people have been evacuated.

answer.title: Floods force thousands from homes
bullets: Rivers burst banks in Austria and Czechia
answer.voiceover: BBC News reports heavy rain across central Europe. Rivers have burst their banks in Austria and Czechia, and thousands of people have been evacuated.
